( <@!237577351532249110> so whenever you can )
When you enter you see the Mender sitting on a bench at the entryway.  he motions for you to sitdown and casts tongues on you again
Roy takes a seat. <I suppose I'll still be able to understand you?>
"you can.  I made sure we could communicate"

"If you know sylvan or undercommon we could've just used either, I suppose, but well, this definitely works." Roy's expression turns a bit more serious. "Sorry, but I don't think you just wanted to have an idle chat. It's something important, isn't it?"
"You have expressed a lack of focus and goal to your life correct?"

"I suppose so. At first, I was just tinkering with machines."

"Then, my family *volunteered* me to a mission of setting up foundations for our swarm to expand or move across the ocean, in case the wars of the gods would directly threaten our communities."

"Here, I initially found people not too interested in joining our community. I don't know what my family expected, but I was not going to take anyone by force. So, I went back to what had been bringing me satisfaction before - machines."

"Then, the curfew started, and the tensions kept rising. I could no longer find much to do. People around have been rising up to stand up to the oppression, proud and confident. I didn't feel like I could keep up with them, even though I wanted to follow their cause."

"Then, well, as you know, I died. And with the daily meditations since then I've been looking for what I can do. And yesterday, I felt some inspiration. And you were there later too, so you know what I mean. I'm just disappointed I didn't think of it sooner. I'm a mechanic. I fix things. And now I follow the path of a Mender. The fight is necessary to keep the freedom, but someone still has to repair what was broken in those fights."

"I don't know if that's what my true goal is. But for just this moment, it feels like one."
he listens quietly "You als oexpressed a desire to help me mend that which is broken?"

"I believe that could be an extension of what I decided to start doing on a small scale now. Though I can't imagine that if I couldn't keep up with others in the docks, I could bring anything to the table that would compare with what you can do."
(on a different note, I think Crui might need a moment till she can compose herself enough to note the indirect reference to Gil I made in the other server)
(rofl)
"as one of my followers, I know you will not betray me, as that would move you out of sync with me.  So what you find out in here you cannot tell a soul outside of here.  Understood?"
"Not a soul or any being that might not have one. Not sure if there are any but... just to make sure I don't intend to look for any ways around it."
"the activities of the cottage belong to those of the cottage and only them"
"undersant better?"
"Absolutely. No objections to it at all.

"So I have an offer and if you sayn no, youll go on as you have.  But if you accept, you will be the first to become my helper, and help me fix this broken city.  The Masons preform a service, imbueing items with inheriant magic glyps.  Its more than the normal magic items you deal with.  This is unique.  The top job of the masons is to set cornerstones.  These stones protect settlements from wild magic leylines.  For instance they protect a city from the feywild bleeding over and taking over a section.  Or protect from the shadowfell turning an area of the city monochromatic.  Once set the stone protects the city from said wild magics, but over time the stone wears down.  Enter the Tinkers.  They are tasked to maintain the stones, and make sure they arent broken." he pauses
"I am not a true mason, nor a tinker.  I am a third caste that gets tapped with mending that which is broken"
"So that is why there is Ferrytown and Noir as we have it?"
"To be honest, I just thought this is how things just are sometimes on this side of the ocean."
"as I said, something is broken here.  Each area of the city has one or more stones that the masons and tinkers have neglected"

"this entire city is falling apart.  So with very little knowledge, I have been tasked to mend that which is broken.  And to do that, I need followers that will help me.  So do you wish to become a Mender and help me repair this city?

"Earlier today, when talking with Sabrine and Seraxa, I said that it's the people that make the city more than its buildings. But... even if we put the buildings back, even if we let people live here, if it is as you're saying that things are going so wrong even layers below that, then that must take priority. You can't start pouring in fuel and expecting to move, if half of your engine is across the room."

"I'll be honest. From the very start this sounds like very much something beyond me. I'm just a guy from a small town, shooting a bow, messing with machines, and talking to bugs. But you know more than I do. That was always clear. So I can only assume that for some reason you think I can actually be of any help, even if I don't."

"What would I need to do?"
"say you accept being  a mason as a mender, and be ready for when i find more.  Once we have a few people we will be able to start the real work"
"I... I accept. I accept being a mender for the Masons. If there's something I can repair, I'll do my best. Bivur swarm will answer the call, and I hope your trust is well placed."
"Welcome to the masons, and the cottage, Mender Roy"
"Mender Roy. That sounds... quite nice. But I suppose outside the cottage, I'll stick to my usual 'Roy, a mechanic'."
